note: Conceptual/process lesson on approval governance, not tied to any single vendor UI (approval workflows are typically implemented through a mix of registry metadata, ticketing/review tools, and organizational process rather than one screenshot-able screen), so per SCREENSHOTS.md's documented exception for non-visual/process lessons, no screenshot is used. The five-gate structure (development, technical validation, risk/compliance review, business sign-off, production approval) reflects standard MLOps governance practice described in Google Cloud's and Microsoft's own MLOps guidance, generalized rather than tied to one product's specific workflow tool.
